project.name: SMIOT Smart Farm Operations Center
project.purpose: Trung tâm quan sát và phục hồi có kiểm soát cho 10 nhà màng dưa lưới mô phỏng.
project.scope: greenhouse_a through greenhouse_j; telemetry, virtual devices, MongoDB Community, MQTT, SMIOT web app, Datadog monitors/workflows/Bits, guarded AWS recovery.
project.safety_boundary: Không điều khiển phần cứng thật. PLC/interlock ảo là lớp an toàn tức thời; Datadog quan sát, điều tra, điều phối và xác minh.
project.level_5_definition: monitor phát hiện -> điều tra nhiều nguồn -> hành động đúng hoặc từ chối an toàn -> kiểm tra health và dữ liệu MongoDB mới -> app xác nhận phục hồi; mọi bước dùng cùng incident_id.
project.important_truth: Workflow published hoặc Success không tự động đồng nghĩa Level 5; chỉ kết luận theo bằng chứng runtime.

secrets_and_environment.datadog_key_file_format: APP_KEY=<application_key> and api_keys=<api_key>; read privately only, never print or commit.
rules: Local .env is private and ignored by Git.
On EC2 use root-owned EnvironmentFile files; never paste values into chat.
Terraform receives credentials through process environment or secret manager only.
Do not put secrets into JSON, tfvars, tfstate, screenshots, logs or S3 evidence.

aws.if_session_expired: Run aws login --profile aws-moi --region ap-southeast-2 in the user's interactive session, finish browser authentication, then repeat the identity check.
aws.rule: Do not substitute the default profile or a different AWS project/account. Confirm the target EC2 instance ID before deployment.

smiot_web.procedure: Read the local admin credential file privately, sign in through the SMIOT login page, and verify that the Admin role and required pages are accessible. Do not copy the password into the project, a prompt, logs, screenshots or Git.
smiot_web.health_check: GET /healthz is available without login; it does not prove the admin session works.

datadog.procedure: Confirm the signed-in user and organization/site in the browser before writes. For API/Terraform, load the API and application key from the local file into the process environment without printing values; validate access with a read-only call first.
datadog.rule: Do not use dashboard, monitor or workflow IDs from the historical organization snapshot as current resources.

ec2_runtime.procedure: Inspect file existence, ownership and required variable names only; do not print values or copy env files into evidence.

access_guide.failure_reporting: If access fails, report the service, identity/profile/site, exact read-only check that failed and the resulting error type; do not silently switch account.

cloud.aws_account_context: Use aws-moi profile; verify identity before every write.

ec2.role: EC2 instance role is used for SSM, S3 backup access and runtime operations; inspect live policy before changing.
ec2.public_health: GET /healthz returns app, MongoDB, MQTT and telemetry freshness status.
ec2.deployment_pattern: Upload source/scripts through SSM Run Command or the repository deployment scripts; restart only the SMIOT app when required.
do_not: Do not reboot EC2 for synthetic drills

storage.mongodb: MongoDB Community 8.0 self-managed on the same EC2; operational store, not Atlas in current deployment.
storage.s3: Traceability images and backup artifacts use S3; bucket is configured through TRACEABILITY_IMAGE_BUCKET.
storage.backup: MongoDB backup/restore drill scripts are in scripts/aws; Time Series is exported through collection API when mongodump cannot read system.buckets.telemetry.

flow: virtual device publishers -> MQTT farm/sensor and farm/control/status topics
Smiot MQTT handler -> MongoDB Time Series telemetry and operational collections
application health/detector/actuator producers -> Datadog metrics, logs and APM traces
Datadog monitor -> Bits investigation and Workflow Automation
workflow -> guarded app/API/SSM action or safe refusal
verifier -> /healthz + fresh MongoDB telemetry + action ledger
app notification and Incident black box -> operator UI

layers.edge: Virtual PLC/interlock: immediate safe-stop, pump OFF, valve close, ACK.
layers.application: Python/NiceGUI, MQTT callbacks, detector heartbeat, agronomic thresholds, incident ledger and verifier.
layers.data: MongoDB Time Series plus operational collections, indexes, validation and evidence records.
layers.observability: Datadog US1 metrics, logs, APM traces, monitors, workflows, Bits and dashboards.
layers.cloud: EC2, SSM guarded recovery, Nginx HTTPS, S3 image/backup storage.

mongodb.role: Nguồn dữ liệu vận hành chính và bộ nhớ bằng chứng của trung tâm.

collections.telemetry: Time Series collection; timestamp, meta, readings, source/provenance.
collections.operational_incidents: Incident lifecycle, evidence, status, recovery and scope.
collections.action_ledger: Commands, safety decisions, ACKs, late ACK and verification.
collections.notifications: App bell notifications and workflow correlation, idempotent by run ID.
collections.crop_cycles: Season/lot records, fruit_set_at, harvest windows and GDD context.
collections.traceability_events: Lot/stage/day metadata and image key/path; image bytes live in app/S3 storage.
collections.stage_envelopes: Versioned agronomic advisory ranges; do not treat uncalibrated values as field truth.

showcase_queries: $graphLookup for device dependency scope when enabled
TTL for short-lived raw/notification data when configured
mongodb.evidence_rule: Chỉ báo MongoDB feature là đã dùng khi có runtime result hoặc artifact; không suy đoán từ code.
mongodb.backup_restore: scripts/aws/mongodb_backup.sh and mongodb_restore_drill.sh; verified collection-level restore exists, EBS snapshot restore is not the same proof.

datadog.account: US1 account; verify identity and current email before writes.

current_dashboards.historical_warning: nkc-685-vw8 is a historical ID from an older organization snapshot and may return 404; do not use it as current source of truth.

datadog.level5_correlation: incident_id is carried in logs/spans/MongoDB/notifications; metrics keep low-cardinality tags and use log/span context for IDs.

items.name: PLC safety trip
items.action: Verify virtual PLC SAFE_STOP, outputs OFF, ACK and Mongo ledger; no physical action.

items.name: Sensor flatline/local interlock
items.action: Confirm backend flatline and hand off HOLD/CLEAR proof to app verifier.

items.name: Guarded EC2 app recovery
items.action: Start only smiot.service when dependencies, disk, instance and health guards pass; never reboot EC2/Mongo/MQTT.

items.name: Status mismatch/refuse restart
items.action: Refuse restart when fresh Mongo data and healthy backend contradict UI offline state.

items.name: MongoDB/MQTT dependency triage
items.action: Compare Mongo and MQTT probes, classify root cause and verify after recovery.

items.name: Detector heartbeat
items.action: Farm-scoped heartbeat and input freshness; distinguish detector death from missing input; recover only scoped detector when allowed.

items.name: Soil moisture/irrigation evidence review
items.action: Advisory/HOLD and human review; no automatic irrigation without approved envelope and ACK.

items.name: VPD/EC crop-risk review
items.action: Evidence review and escalation; no automatic fan/drainage/nutrient action without approval.

items.name: Actuator no-ACK/late ACK
items.action: Timeout, safe output OFF, exact command_id+farm matching, accept late ACK without blind retry.

items.name: AI/provider failure safety
items.action: HOLD/fallback when provider fails or latency is unsafe; never use unverified AI decision to irrigate.

workflows.live_status_note: Each workflow has JSON/Terraform definition and some have recovery evidence; inspect current monitor/workflow run before claiming complete Level 5.

rules: import existing live resources before managing them
apply_prerequisites: DD_API_KEY and DD_APP_KEY in process environment only
review plan for no unintended destroy

/.purpose: 10-farm operations overview; health heatmap/summary from MongoDB latest samples, open incidents and notifications; click a farm to drill down.

/devices.purpose: Virtual device catalog/status; not a physical device registry.

/inverter.purpose: Inverter modes and command/status ACK UI.

/plc.purpose: Virtual PLC controls, safe scenario injection and actuator/interlock evidence.

/schedule.purpose: Irrigation schedule, operator state, run history and controls.

/chart.purpose: Operational charts and links to canonical Datadog dashboards.

/data.purpose: Raw/filtered telemetry and operational data table.

/mongodb-lab.purpose: MongoDB showcase: Time Series, aggregation, setWindowFields, GDD/harvest context and query evidence.

/traceability.purpose: Lot/stage traceability with metadata from MongoDB and image references.

/incident.purpose: Incident black-box list, scenario cards, monitor/workflow links and status filtering.

/incident/{incident_id}.purpose: Single incident timeline: metrics, logs/traces links, evidence questions, action, verification and affected scope.

services.main.py: App startup, healthz, demo control, workflow notification endpoint, recovery verifier routes and NiceGUI bootstrap.
services.service/mqtt.py: MQTT subscriptions, virtual device commands/status, telemetry ingestion and ACK handling.
services.service/mongodb_telemetry.py: Time Series reads/writes and telemetry persistence.
services.service/telemetry_health.py: Freshness, online/stale/offline and flatline logic based on actual samples.
services.service/incident_lifecycle.py: Incident state transitions and idempotent lifecycle.
services.service/incident_blackbox.py: Black-box timeline and evidence aggregation; normalizes node1/node2 identifiers.
services.service/scenario_catalog.py: Canonical 36 scenario catalog; do not create a second catalog.
services.service/scenario_recovery.py: Scenario state and safe recovery semantics.
services.service/scenario_domain_*.py: Virtual crop, sensor/device, actuator and infrastructure scenario domains.
services.service/agronomic_thresholds.py: Shared advisory thresholds; current values are demo/advisory and not field-calibrated.
services.service/ai_service.py: Gemini/provider calls and safe HOLD fallback.
services.service/ai_tools.py: AI tools exposed to the app.
services.service/datadog_reader.py: Read-only Datadog snapshots for incident pages; cache and safe fallback.
services.service/w3_recovery_verification.py: Post-action verifier for health, dependency state, SSM result and fresh Mongo telemetry.
services.service/traceability.py: Traceability metadata and S3 image URL/key handling.

folder_map.pages/: NiceGUI route modules and UI components.
folder_map.service/: Application domain, persistence, telemetry, observability and safety services.
folder_map.scripts/: Seeders, drills, deployment helpers, probes, Datadog readback and AWS SSM wrappers.
folder_map.infra/: Terraform for Datadog workflows and AWS telemetry credential plumbing.
folder_map.deploy/datadog/: Terraform modules for monitors, scenarios and five control-center dashboards.
folder_map.docs/: Architecture, blueprint, recovery runbooks, Datadog snapshots and evidence documentation.
folder_map.outputs/: Sanitized workflow exports, drill results, deployment evidence and submission artifacts.
folder_map.tests/: Unit/integration tests for telemetry, MQTT virtual devices, workflow contracts and safety logic.
folder_map.static/: Browser assets and legacy PLC/inverter pages; inspect references before removal.
folder_map.wokwi/: ESP32/Wokwi demo assets; Wokwi is optional and not the continuous cloud publisher.
folder_map.logs/: Local operational logs; never commit secrets.

local: use demo scenario scripts with synthetic=true
safe_drill: verify MongoDB fresh samples and action ledger
confirm monitor OK and app notification
runbooks.w6_specific: To clear W6, use scripts/restore_w6_all_farms.ps1, wait for the Datadog last_5m evaluator window, then run scripts/check_w6_live.py. Do not claim clear until all ten groups are OK.
runbooks.incident_debug: If /incident/{id} reports invalid literal for node1, verify service/incident_blackbox.py normalization and deployed revision; current fix accepts node1 and numeric IDs.

current_known_gaps: Some workflow cards may have monitor/workflow but no MongoDB operational incident evidence; do not label them recovered.
W3 automatic monitor-trigger path and true service-down branch require separate proof from manual/API runs.
W9 clean workflow acceptance after a live late ACK is separate from app-side late-ACK unit tests.
W7/W8 agronomic thresholds are advisory until field/cultivar calibration and approval.
SLO and AWS billing windows may not have enough historical data for final claims.
Wokwi CLI/session is optional and not the continuous cloud telemetry source.
MongoDB and app on one EC2 are a demo single point of failure, not HA production architecture.
handoff_checklist: Read this file, PRD.md, PROJECT_MEMORY_HANDOFF.md, docs/CONTROL_CENTER_BLUEPRINT.md and ACTIVITY_LOG.md.
Verify current account/site before Datadog writes.
Verify AWS identity with aws-moi/ap-southeast-2 before EC2 writes.
Use access_guide for AWS CLI, SMIOT admin login and Datadog US1; never expose credential values.
Inspect current live state; do not trust historical IDs or screenshots.
Keep secrets outside repository and outputs.
Record every deployment, drill, run ID, monitor ID and evidence artifact in ACTIVITY_LOG.md.
